[{{fullurl:File:Griffon's Mouth non-interactive map.jpg|redirect=no}} Non-interactive map] | ingame name=Griffon's Mouth | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=027 }} {{TOCright}} The [[Griffon's Mouth]] refers to a small cave system with dead end paths that connects the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] to the borders of [[Kryta]]. The way is not without its dangers as [[Snow Ettin]]s call this place home. ==Getting there== The [[To Kryta: The Ice Cave]] [[primary quest]] will lead [[Prophecies]] characters through this map. It can also be accessed from [[Beacon's Perch]] via [[Deldrimor Bowl]]. Characters from other campaigns must travel from [[Lion's Arch]] through [[North Kryta Province]] and [[Scoundrel's Rise]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *Northeast, at the exit into [[Deldrimor Bowl]]. *Southwest, at the exit into [[Scoundrel's Rise]]. ==Quests available== *[[Master Seeker Nathaniel]] **[[To Kryta: The Ice Cave]] {{Quest icon|Primary}} *[[Aidan]] **[[To Kryta: Journey's End]] {{Quest icon|Primary}} ==NPCs== These quests affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: *[[To Kryta: The Ice Cave]] ===Allies=== *{{w}} 5 (20) [[Snow]] (Nathaniel's [[animal companion]]) *{{r}} 12 (20) [[Master Seeker Nathaniel]] ===Foes=== [[Elemental]]s *{{e}} 10 (24) [[Ice Golem]] [[Ettin]]s *{{w}} 11 (24) [[Snow Ettin]] ====Bosses==== [[Drake]]s *{{e}} 14 (28) [[Whiskar Featherstorm]] [[Ettin]]s *{{w}} 12 (27) [[Snow Ettin (warrior boss)|Snow Ettin]] *{{mo}} 12 (27) [[Snow Ettin (monk boss)|Snow Ettin]] ==Notes== *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.4% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *Often people [[running]] through this area experience [[rubber-banding]] as they are trying to pass by groups of ettins, which can prove troubling for those without [[shadow step]]s. *{{Vanquisher|count = 45|low = 42|high = 53}} *[[Hero]]es and [[henchmen]] often remain stuck at some several places in the ice cave, there is currently no known reason for this. {{bug| *On the southern part of this area, where ice paths can be found, you actually walk through the ice instead of walking on it. *There is an invisible wall between the exit from the cave into the forest area, north of the southern resurrection shrine and west across the wall from Whiskar Featherstorm.}} ==Trivia== * [[Nicholas the Traveler]] believes that the area might be haunted. {{Explorable areas in the Northern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Greifenmaul]]
